name: OW6H-first-sight-unsaid
note: A spawn's first sight never reaches the cell: every client keeps its own clock.

name: OW6H-sight-always-said
note: A sight already known said again at every build.

name: OW6H-clear-unsaid
old: owSayRow(key);   // OW6L: and the cell hears the short clock start
note: A spawn's clear never reaches the cell.

name: OW6H-band-spend-unsaid
old: owSaySpent(id);   // OW6L: and the cell keeps it, for everyone there and whoever comes
note: A band fought is gone only for those whose frames heard it, that minute.

name: OW6H-raider-spend-unsaid
old: owSaySpent(id);   // OW6L: and the cell keeps it
note: A raider that boarded one crew stands again for the next.

name: OW6H-rest-dropped
note: What the cell did not take is never said again.

name: OW6H-old-relay-spoken-to
note: A relay that keeps no ledger is asked to (and would close the socket).

name: OW6H-raider-read-as-band
note: A spent raider taken for a band: the raider sails on.

name: OW6H-list-never-reread
old: if (moved) tvDng.at = null;   // the Overworld's dungeons read again: a spawn now gone leaves its list
note: A spawn gone on someone else's clock stays on the Overworld's list.

name: OW6H-unheard
old: online.onOverworld = (msg) => (msg?.k === 'gr' ? searchPartyHeard(msg) : overworldLedgerHeard(msg));   // OW6L: my cell's (and a halo's) overworld ledger - its welcome, and each change; GRAVE-PARTY: its graves searched, to the search party's own door (scenes/searchPartyHost.js)
note: The cell's word never heard. PIN MOVED (FIELD BUGS 2026-10-16b GRAVE-PARTY): the line routes the graves' rows to the search party first - re-aimed by content.

name: OW6H-never-said
old: overworldLedgerFrame(now); searchPartyFrame(now);   // OW6L: what I spent and my spawns' clocks, to the cell that keeps them; GRAVE-PARTY: and the stones I searched
note: What is owed is never said. PIN MOVED (FIELD BUGS 2026-10-16b GRAVE-PARTY): the line says the stones searched beside it - re-aimed by content.

name: OW6H-load-keeps-owed
old: _owSay.sp.clear(); _owSay.dg.clear();   // OW6L: nor what the abandoned run still owed its cell (the loaded ledger is the save's)
note: A load says the abandoned run's rows for the loaded character.
